execution_phases.name: preflight
requirements: verify repo identity and reviewed decision payload hashes
verify frozen V6 parent SHA-256 and Schema V6 identity
verify both source artifacts through CAS get/verify
verify no active promotion lock owned by another execution

execution_phases.name: isolated_staging_copy
requirements: copy frozen parent DB to execution-scoped temporary staging path
verify staging SHA-256 equals parent before first write
never open parent DB writable
staging path must not equal final content-addressed snapshot path

execution_phases.name: transactional_reviewed_replay
requirements: BEGIN IMMEDIATE on staging only
insert rows in foreign-key-safe deterministic dependency order
use exact reviewed IDs and reviewed payload identities
use exact CAS source bytes and verify all derived representation hashes
fail on preexisting conflicting row identity
rollback entire transaction on any mismatch
COMMIT only after complete scientific replay validates

execution_phases.name: post_replay_validation
requirements: PRAGMA quick_check == ok
PRAGMA foreign_key_check returns zero rows
schema user_version remains 6
schema design SHA remains frozen V6 design SHA
expected table deltas match exactly
knowledge_syntheses delta equals zero
source_lineage_edges delta equals zero
reviewed evidence-assessment policy version is stable
run full repo regression suite

execution_phases.name: immutable_publication
requirements: close staging SQLite connection before final DB SHA-256
compute final database SHA-256
final directory is content-addressed by final database SHA-256
publish database create-only
refuse overwrite of mismatching existing target
write canonical snapshot-manifest.json sidecar create-only
manifest parent_kind is legacy_root
manifest parent_manifest_sha256 is null
manifest records runtime and promotion-engine identities

execution_phases.name: final_verify
requirements: reopen published snapshot read-only
verify published DB SHA-256
quick_check and FK check again
verify canonical manifest payload and manifest SHA-256
verify frozen parent V6 SHA-256 is still unchanged
do not modify active pointer

promotion_engine_contract_payload.purpose: deterministically replay already-reviewed scientific persistence state from the frozen V6 legacy root into an isolated staging copy

transaction_boundary.published_content_addressed_artifact_rol: never delete a verified preexisting immutable snapshot
